findings.title: Factory owner is an EOA, not a multisig
findings.detail: factory.owner() = 0xA6E9ca903eb048da8Bb7b2F620b6947121731dA5 has no contract code. A single private key controls fee-tier governance (enableFeeAmount + setOwner). If compromised, attacker can add malicious fee tiers permanently.

findings.detail: TWAP is unavailable; downstream protocols using these as price oracles are vulnerable to single-block manipulation.
